canonical_name: Jazz Showcase & Jam (curated by Steven Alvarez)
summary: A weekly Thursday night, 7-10pm, no-cover series at Shamrock Irons Irish Pub in downtown Asheville: a curated jazz showcase of booked/professional musicians (curator Steven Alvarez) followed by an open jam where 'qualified players' sit in. It reads as venue-run commercial programming rather than a self-organized community: musicians apply through the venue's own Artist Booking Form, and there is no membership language, named regulars, or independent group identity (Facebook group, Discord, etc.) separate from the pub's own event listings.

evidence.note: Listing says the showcase is 'curated by Steven Alvarez' with a 'rotating roster of local players' - framed as curated programming, not a member club.
Description: 'jazz showcase followed by an open jam where players trade improvised solos and sit-ins' with 'spontaneous combos' - open participation, not a named returning core.

Venue FAQ describes it as 'our weekly Thursday jazz series featuring professional musicians followed by an open jam session where qualified players can sit in and perform' - no membership, dues, or community language.
Musicians who want to perform submit an Artist Booking Form with samples and links - a commercial booking process run by the venue, not a self-organizing group signing up peers.

Web search turned up only the venue's own pages (shamrockirons.com), Mountain Xpress/LiveMusicAsheville listings, and Bandsintown - no dedicated Facebook group, Meetup, or 'about us' page for a jazz jam community independent of the pub.
